create_eval_transform_request: create an OpenAI eval by transforming a CreateEvalRequest into the API request body
list_evals_transform_request: list all OpenAI evals by transforming ListEvalsParams into a URL and query parameters
get_eval_transform_request: get a single OpenAI eval by eval_id and return the request URL
create_run_transform_request: create a run for a given eval_id by transforming CreateRunRequest into the API request body
list_runs_transform_request: list all runs for a given eval_id by transforming ListRunsParams into a URL and query parameters
